<thought>To determine the number of aromatic carbons, I will first obtain the 13C NMR spectrum of the sample using the carbon_nmr_spectra tool. Then I will retrieve typical carbon chemical shift ranges to identify which peaks correspond to aromatic carbons (generally ~110‑160 ppm). By counting those peaks, I can provide the integer count required.</thought>
